4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Golden candlesticks stood along the length of the table in the royal dining room.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: My mother hurried into the room, holding the train of her silk brocade gown. Pabel calmly pulled out her chair.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Their flickering light cast a warm glow on my daughter's face -- a stark contrast to the coldness in her eyes.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Their flickering light cast a warm glow on my daughter's face, matching the warmth in her eyes.

11.speaker: Estela Toras
11.text: "Truly sorry, dears. It took two ladies-in-waiting to squeeze me into this old thing."

12.speaker: Estela Toras
12.text: "But I wouldn't miss supper for the world. It's been ages since the three of us sat around the same table."

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "Even among the myriad demands of war, a king must make time for his family."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Yes, even among the many pressures of ruling, a king must make time for his family."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "The four of us. Isn't that right, Pabel?"

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Come off it, Mother. You must know that Vina can hardly stand me these days. But we Torases have appearances to keep up."

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: My butler demurred, his face a mask of civility.

24.speaker: Pabel Adria
24.text: "I'm only here to serve, Your Majesty."

25.speaker: Pabel Adria
25.text: "You honor me, Your Majesty. But I'm only here to serve."

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: My mother took a long glance at Vina. She spoke up cheerfully.

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Vina's been highly in demand since her stint in Pales. I'm lucky if I can get an audience with her."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "It's been a hard year for Vina. I wanted to give her time to process her feelings."

49.speaker: Vina Toras
49.text: "You scared him off. I don't know what you threatened him with, but it must have been terrible."
49.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true) == false)

50.speaker: Vina Toras
50.text: "He wasn't plotting anything. You had him framed."

51.speaker: Vina Toras
51.text: "He wasn't plotting anything. You had a hand in his disappearance."
51.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true)

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: Vina smiled in spite of herself.

57.speaker: Estela Toras
57.text: "Nothing that a little liquid refreshment can't cure."

58.speaker: Vina Toras
58.text: "You sent him to Pales. You knew he would die, and you sent him anyway."

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: My daughter managed a weak smile.

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: Pabel rang a small bell. An army of kitchen staff materialized around the table, bearing plates of food.

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: He fastidiously wiped the dust off an ancient-looking wine bottle before pouring glasses for Vina and my mother, then me.

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: He fastidiously wiped the dust off an ancient-looking wine bottle before pouring glasses for Vina and my mother. I received my usual non-alcoholic substitute.

64.speaker: Pabel Adria
64.text: "A rare Cantuavo Grand Cru. Bottled in 1926, days prior to the uprising."

65.speaker: Player_Romus
65.text: "I bet it's aged more gracefully than I have."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "A reminder of triumph over our seditious internal elements. Well chosen."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Take it away. I can't stand to be reminded of that time."

71.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
71.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)) == false

72.speaker: Pabel Adria
72.text: "There aren't many new wines coming out of the vineyard these days. Soil damage from the gold mines, if I recall correctly."

73.speaker: Pabel Adria
73.text: "I've had no choice but to go back through the old vintages. I do hope you enjoy this one."

75.speaker: Estela Toras
75.text: "Heavy is the head that wears the crown, but even heavier are the under-eye bags."

76.speaker: Pabel Adria
76.text: "I'm so sorry, Your Majesty. I'll have another brought at once."

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: He gestured to the staff, who quickly removed our wine glasses and replaced them with new ones.

87.speaker: Pabel Adria
87.text: "Pardon my interruption, but dinner is served."

91.speaker: Vina Toras
91.text: "My stint as a near-hostage, you mean. A pity nothing came of it."

93.speaker: Pabel Adria
93.text: "An exceptional vintage for a special occasion."
93.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_RizianWineIndustry"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == true)) == false

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: Pabel bowed and disappeared back into the kitchen.

98.speaker: Pabel Adria
98.text: "This one's called Dandelion. A gift from our trade partners in Sordland."

99.speaker: Pabel Adria
99.text: "From our store of Romus the Red. I recall Her Highness was quite fond of that one."

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: I looked down at my plate. Dinner tonight was Monqiz lobster with rice and plenty of butter.

101.speaker: Estela Toras
101.text: "Remind me. Do the crustaceans in Monqiz now belong to Rumburg as well?"

105.speaker: Estela Toras
105.text: "Your father couldn't stand lobster as a child, Vina. I could only get him to eat it by telling him it was a magical creature called a sea pheasant."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "Wait. There's no such thing as a sea pheasant?"

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "That's not true, Vina. Mother, stop telling lies about the King."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "They must. This one precisely resembles Queen Beatrice."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "Keep up your wisecracks and this will be a very short dinner."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I did what I had to, Mother. History will vindicate me."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "An example of how we all believe what we want to, no matter how implausible."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Do not disparage our Rumburgian allies. They're giving us sorely needed aid."

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: My mother snickered. Vina didn't respond.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: My mother looked down at her plate. Vina didn't respond.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: My mother gave me an abashed look. Vina didn't respond.

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: My mother mouthed an apology. Vina didn't respond.

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: My mother nodded in agreement. Vina didn't respond.

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Well, Vina? Are you enjoying your dinner?"

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "Vina. This is a family dinner and you will participate in family conversations."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "What's on your mind, Vina? You know you can tell me anything."

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: Vina picked at her food, still preoccupied.

133.speaker: Vina Toras
133.text: "I had a long conversation with Manus the other day."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "What? How dare he discuss marriage without first asking the King for your hand?"

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "The topic came up? Is he too cowardly to propose to you?"

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "Aha. I knew you'd come running to me about this sooner or later."

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: She slowly put down her fork.

142.speaker: Vina Toras
142.text: "Our relationship is more egalitarian than that, Father."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: She breathed a sigh of relief.

144.speaker: Vina Toras
144.text: "Lovely indeed! So does that mean we can go through with it?"

147.speaker: Vina Toras
147.text: "I will ask you now. Do we have your permission to marry?"

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Before I agree, there is another marriage opportunity that we must discuss."
148.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

150.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
150.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

151.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
151.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true) == false

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I couldn't be happier with your decision. Let us begin planning the wedding at once."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Vina, I promised you long ago that I would not influence your marriage. I shall keep that promise."

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Vina pushed away her plate with a stunned expression.

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: Vina pushed away her plate with a stunned look on her face. My mother frowned.

163.speaker: Estela Toras
163.text: "Romus, darling, are you quite sure about this?"

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "House Toras must hold the throne for a thousand years, as the Lord Himself ordained."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "The future of our lineage is at stake. If Vina does not marry a fellow Toras, I fear a coup from within our house."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "We cannot dilute the blood of our house any further. This is the only way to consolidate power within the family."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "Ricardus and the patriots of Su Omina have been good allies to us. They should be rewarded."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "I saw the way you looked at him at the gas deal signing. You like him."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Vina Toras, Queen of Rizia and Grand Duchess of Pales. Doesn't that have a nice ring to it?"

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "It would be foolish to refuse the benefits this union will bring to our kingdom."

180.speaker: Vina Toras
180.text: "Yes, I think he's handsome. Everyone does."

181.speaker: Vina Toras
181.text: "And he's much kinder than the media makes him out to be."

186.speaker: Vina Toras
186.text: "We discussed it. And I agreed to broach the subject with you before we went any further."

189.speaker: Vina Toras
189.text: "Marry my cousin, or get usurped? Those are my choices?"

190.speaker: Vina Toras
190.text: "And incestuous relations are part of His plan?"

194.speaker: Vina Toras
194.text: "That is all I ever asked! Thank you."

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "And I suppose you have absolutely no interest in knowing that the Duke of Pales has asked for your hand in marriage."

196.speaker: Vina Toras
196.text: "Perhaps that's the way things worked in the past. Today, other nations will see us as inbred lunatics."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: She looked helplessly at her grandmother. Estela had a frozen expression on her face.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: Vina frowned. She seemed to be weighing the title in her mind.

205.speaker: Vina Toras
205.text: "I'll admit I enjoyed getting to know Axel. He's much kinder than the media makes him out to be."

207.speaker: Vina Toras
207.text: "Benefits that you and Mr. Reinhart have discussed without my involvement, I assume?"

208.speaker: Vina Toras
208.text: "First off, I object to you and the Duke of Pales discussing this without my involvement. As to the marriage itself..."

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: She slowly and deliberately put down her fork.
209.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true)

213.speaker: Vina Toras
213.text: "I can't bear it anymore. Father, did you do it?"

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: My mother went pale. She shot Vina a look of warning.

215.speaker: Estela Toras
215.text: "Honey, please. Not at the dinner table."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "What is it that you think I did?"

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "I agree. Let us move on to a more pleasant topic."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "It's quite all right. Yes, I was the one who passed gas just now."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "Please go on, Vina. You can ask me anything."

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: My daughter stared at me with hollow eyes.

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "I was in the middle of working with Manus. Why would I want to dispose of him?"

229.speaker: Estela Toras
229.text: "Now, Vina. Don't forget that your venerable great-grandmother married within the family as well."

233.speaker: Vina Toras
233.text: "You sent him to Pales to keep him away from me. He's no soldier. He could die at any time."

236.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
236.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_AxelDiscussion"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_RicoDiscussion"] == false)) == false

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "You were blinded by the hearts in your eyes. House Sazon was using you all along."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "The wound is still fresh. So I will forgive your rash outburst, but not your slanderous accusation."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "Vina, you have to understand. Manus wasn't safe in Rizia."

240.speaker: Vina Toras
240.text: "I don't know! But it's no coincidence you brought Duchess Angelica back right after he left."

244.speaker: Vina Toras
244.text: "You never liked Manus. It was all a ruse."

245.speaker: Vina Toras
245.text: "You never liked Manus. You made that obvious enough."

249.speaker: Vina Toras
249.text: "I don't know! One of your capricious whims, maybe?"

250.speaker: Vina Toras
250.text: "He's not bloody safe now, is he?!"

254.speaker: Vina Toras
254.text: "And why would that be? Because of this bloody family!"

255.speaker: Vina Toras
255.text: "You're wrong. I knew him. What we had together... that was real."

256.speaker: Vina Toras
256.text: "Don't bloody patronize me! I know what you are!"

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "Sweetheart... I know you're sad. But that's no reason to take it out on me."

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: Vina seemed close to tears. My butler discreetly offered her a kerchief.

262.speaker: Vina Toras
262.text: "This is what you do to people you hate, isn't it? Why, I wouldn't be surprised if you're the reason Mother... Mother..."

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: She started sobbing. Estela rushed over to her side of the table and embraced her tightly.

264.speaker: Estela Toras
264.text: "There, there, darling. Let it all out."

265.speaker: Vina Toras
265.text: "Did you ever really want me on the council? Or was that just to keep me busy while you... you..."

271.speaker: Estela Toras
271.text: "It seems like the end of the world now, I know. But you've got your entire life ahead of you."

272.speaker: Vina Toras
272.text: "Slanderous! How can you sit there calmly and say that?"

273.speaker: Vina Toras
273.text: "This is why you didn't want me on the council, isn't it? To keep me out of the way while you... you..."

274.speaker: Estela Toras
274.text: "You'll fall in love again. And you'll look back on your present self and laugh at what a silly little girl she was, getting so hung up over someone she barely even knew."

275.speaker: Narrator
275.text: Vina took a long, shaky breath.

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "I know how much Manus meant to you. I would never do anything to hurt him."

280.speaker: Estela Toras
280.text: "If this is what your father thinks is best for the kingdom, I suggest you go along with it."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "Your grandmother's right, Vina. Your heartache will pass."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Manus may be gone, but you and I can still finish what he started."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "I wish I could give you more time to heal your broken heart. But your kingdom needs you."

288.speaker: Estela Toras
288.text: "I'm afraid so. After all, I'm the reason this particular branch of the Toras family nearly got chopped off the tree."

293.speaker: Estela Toras
293.text: "I wish it weren't up to you to shore up our roots. But we women must do what needs to be done to protect the line of succession."

305.speaker: Vina Toras
305.text: "I know. I'm sorry for my outburst."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Vina, there's something I need to bring up with you."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "You know how fond I am of Manus. But I have an even more suitable marriage candidate in mind for you."
318.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "I don't trust Rico or his cronies. I want Vina to be my eyes on the inside."

320.speaker: Vina Toras
320.text: "If you want eyes on the inside, send a spy. Don't sacrifice your daughter."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "Marry Rico, and nobody will challenge your position as Queen of Rizia. The reforms we've been planning will only be the beginning."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Imagine what the throne could do if we channeled the full power of Su Omina. Nobody would dare stand in our way."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "We are at war. Every action we take as the Royal Family, no matter how personal, must be done with the kingdom's stability in mind."

328.speaker: Vina Toras
328.text: "How will a union borne of mutual resentment lead to stability?"

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "Think about it. As Prince Consort, that idiot will be completely under our thumb. He won't be able to do any more damage."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Manus himself will agree that maintaining peace and order in Rizia is more important than your little love affair."

334.speaker: Vina Toras
334.text: "What about Uncle Hugo? I doubt he'll sit by and let it happen."

335.speaker: Vina Toras
335.text: "If you think that's what I want, you're madder than he is."

336.speaker: Vina Toras
336.text: "He shouldn't be under our thumb. He should be in prison."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "Marry Rico, and nobody will challenge your position as Queen of Rizia. You'll be able to make as many radical decrees as you want."

344.speaker: Vina Toras
344.text: "Are you sure of that? Perhaps I should ask him."

346.speaker: Vina Toras
346.text: "But I am not in love with him."

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "Feelings do not factor into this equation. You have a chance to make history."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "You will grow to love him over time. It happened with me and your mother."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "Mr. Sazon will understand that the historic reunification of Rizia and Pales takes precedence over your little affair."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "You will grow to love him over time. I am sure of it."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "I don't need to tell you how important alliances between monarchies are, Vina. You yourself are the product of one."

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: Her voice dripped with sarcasm. Estela clicked her tongue.

357.speaker: Vina Toras
357.text: "You'd never been in love before. How could you even know that was what you felt?"

358.speaker: Estela Toras
358.text: "Your great-uncle is in his seventies, sweetheart. With luck, he'll be long gone by the time you ascend the throne."

359.speaker: Estela Toras
359.text: "Vina, please. Just listen to your father."

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "I know you're still hung up on Manus. But please try to see the bigger picture."

361.speaker: Vina Toras
361.text: "I see the bigger picture, and it's scaring me."

364.speaker: Vina Toras
364.text: "Unifying kingdoms through a loveless marriage. Yes, that sounds like history to me."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "This is a great burden I am placing on you, I know. But I wouldn't be asking it of you if I did not think you could bear it."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "I am only asking you to go along with this betrothal for now. We can revisit the situation once peace has been restored."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "I am only asking you to go along with this betrothal for now. We can revisit the situation once we have a firmer grip on the throne."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "I shall not be so cruel as to force you into an unhappy marriage, Vina. You are free to marry Manus if you wish."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "I am not going to force you to marry your cousin. But I cannot allow you to wed the Sazon heir."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "This is not a request. You will marry Ricardus or face the guillotine."

386.speaker: Vina Toras
386.text: "I... I don't think that I can."

387.speaker: Narrator
387.text: Vina squeezed her eyes shut and opened them.

392.speaker: Narrator
392.text: Vina's back straightened. She spoke with resolve.

397.speaker: Vina Toras
397.text: "My mind is made up. It's Manus or no one."

398.speaker: Vina Toras
398.text: "I would rather stay a spinster my whole life than marry Rico."

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: My mother gripped her silverware so hard that her knuckles turned white. Vina's lip trembled.

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "Your devotion to the Sazon boy is touching. I will grant you permission to wed him."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "Then it is no one. We will put your marriage plans on hold for now."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "I am sorry that I led you to believe you had a choice. You are marrying Ricardus, and that is final."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "You have made yourself heard. We will put your marriage plans on hold for now."

405.speaker: Vina Toras
405.text: "I need a moment. May I please be excused from the table?"

406.speaker: Narrator
406.text: Before I could answer, she pushed back her chair and abruptly stood up.

407.speaker: Narrator
407.text: Estela rose, her eyes full of sorrow.

408.speaker: Estela Toras
408.text: "I'm going to check in on her. She's liable to throw herself off the balcony otherwise."

410.speaker: Narrator
410.text: Without waiting for an answer, she pushed back her chair and stood up.

412.speaker: Narrator
412.text: Estela rose and looked at me approvingly.

413.speaker: Estela Toras
413.text: "Well done, Romus. That can't have been easy."

414.speaker: Estela Toras
414.text: "I should go myself, before my bodice takes any more abuse."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Vina automatically opened her mouth in protest, then registered what I'd said.

416.speaker: Vina Toras
416.text: "If you truly mean that, then thank you. From the bottom of my heart."

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: "Speaking of falling in love again... how open are you to the possibility of another suitor?"
418.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "You have to put your thoughts about Manus aside because another marriage opportunity has arisen. An important one."
419.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

421.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
421.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

422.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
422.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true) == false

426.speaker: Player_Romus
426.text: "You know what'll help you get over Manus? A handsome new fiance."
426.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true)

443.speaker: Pabel Adria
443.text: "I'll pass your compliment on to the chefs, madam."

444.speaker: Narrator
444.text: Pabel showed my mother out the door.

445.speaker: Narrator
445.text: Vina let out a frustrated sigh.

447.speaker: Narrator
447.text: Vina let out a sigh of relief.

449.speaker: Narrator
449.text: She broke into a relieved smile.

450.speaker: Vina Toras
450.text: "I do hope Uncle Hugo won't be too put out."

453.speaker: Vina Toras
453.text: "I'm well aware of that. Although our alliance with Rumburg seems to be crumbling despite my existence."

457.speaker: Vina Toras
457.text: "I'm well aware of that. Aunt Bea never ceases to remind me of it."

458.speaker: Estela Toras
458.text: "All the more reason for you to marry the Duke, sweetheart. Heaven forbid Her Excellency stay cross at us."

459.speaker: Estela Toras
459.text: "All the more reason for you to marry the Duke, sweetheart. Imagine the look on Her Excellency's face."

460.speaker: Vina Toras
460.text: "And do we really want to merge our house with that of the Reinharts?"

461.speaker: Vina Toras
461.text: "But what about the Reinharts? Do we really want to merge our house with theirs?"

462.speaker: Estela Toras
462.text: "Vina. An arranged marriage can turn into genuine affection just as easily as so-called true love can curdle into resentment."

467.speaker: Narrator
467.text: I inadvertently glanced at Pabel. He busied himself polishing some tableware.

468.speaker: Vina Toras
468.text: "That may be so. But what about the Reinharts? Do we really want to merge our house with theirs?"

469.speaker: Player_Romus
469.text: "Careful. You're starting to sound like Chancellor Hegel."

473.speaker: Vina Toras
473.text: "How do you know they'll even be on board with our plans for reform?"

477.speaker: Vina Toras
477.text: "They pillaged continents on behalf of the Valgos Empire, then had riches showered on them by the West. Why should they now be rewarded with the hand of a Rizian princess?"

481.speaker: Vina Toras
481.text: "I have been privy to your conversations about them. Will one marriage be enough to resolve centuries of tension?"

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "This is not a merger, it's an acquisition. Reinhart and his family will fall in line if they want Rizia's protection."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "Reunifying Rizia and Pales will get the rest of the kingdom behind us. They'll have to support whatever we decide."

484.speaker: Player_Romus
484.text: "We can't be certain. But it's a risk we must take."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "It is not as simple as that. Marriage is only the first step in a long process of negotiation and reconciliation."

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "Rizia initiated the aggression against Pales in the first place. It is up to us to offer a peaceful resolution."

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.text: "They showed generosity in their handling of the Aureus gas field affair. I have faith that they will be reliable partners."

493.speaker: Vina Toras
493.text: "I love Manus because he dared to envision a new path for Rizia. A kingdom whose future is determined by all of its citizens, not only those with the most land or titles."

494.speaker: Vina Toras
494.text: "I know you have other ideas. But you allowed us to be together, so you must have been open to compromise."

498.speaker: Vina Toras
498.text: "I thought that's what you wanted, as well."

499.speaker: Vina Toras
499.text: "A marital alliance with another monarchy feels like a step backwards to me."

500.speaker: Vina Toras
500.text: "As much as I've enjoyed being on your council, I still believe our kingdom's citizens should have more of a say in its future."

504.speaker: Vina Toras
504.text: "In the past few years I've dared to dream of a new path for Rizia. One where the land is owned and governed by all, not just those with the most titles."

508.speaker: Vina Toras
508.text: "I thought you shared that vision as well."

509.speaker: Vina Toras
509.text: "I know you don't share that vision. But I always hoped you would come to see it my way."

513.speaker: Vina Toras
513.text: "But a marital alliance with another monarchy... it feels like a step backwards."

517.speaker: Player_Romus
517.text: "What exactly is wrong with a return to the glory days of our Golden Kingdom?"

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "I know it seems that way. But I assure you this partnership will benefit everyone in Rizia. Not only nobles."

519.speaker: Player_Romus
519.text: "You don't understand. Reuniting with Pales will strengthen us enough to end our dependence on Rumburg and GRACE. An entirely new status quo awaits."

523.speaker: Player_Romus
523.text: "I still have every intention of bringing change to Rizia. Our chances of success will be much higher with the wealth and support of Pales behind us."

524.speaker: Player_Romus
524.text: "A monarchical system is not 'backwards' in and of itself. Look at Rumburg and its technological advancements."

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "It's not difficult to understand, Vina. Either you stick to your rigid ideals and die a failure, or marry the Duke and gain wealth and power beyond your wildest imagination."

526.speaker: Vina Toras
526.text: "The glory days for whom, Father? When have ordinary Rizians ever been able to speak up for themselves?"

527.speaker: Vina Toras
527.text: "Have you run that plan by Aunt Bea yet? I'm sure she has other ideas for the Grand Duchy."

528.speaker: Vina Toras
528.text: "Technological progress isn't societal progress. Rumburg isn't any more enlightened just because Aunt Bea's armies can blow up entire cities in one go."

530.speaker: Vina Toras
530.text: "A life lived according to one's ideals is not a failure, Father."

531.speaker: Vina Toras
531.text: "If I marry Reinhart, I intend to hold you to that promise."

535.speaker: Estela Toras
535.text: "Joining the Royal Council has agreed with you, hasn't it?"

536.speaker: Estela Toras
536.text: "You've grown up to become a real spitfire, haven't you?"

537.speaker: Estela Toras
537.text: "I used to be so jealous of noblewomen like you. They'd come into my establishment spending like tycoons and talking like encyclopedias."

538.speaker: Estela Toras
538.text: "But when I joined your ranks, I realized the price of all that privilege. Sooner or later, you've got to put your personal aspirations aside and do your womanly duty on behalf of the kingdom."

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: "I will not try to talk you into marriage with anyone else. You may determine your own future."

540.speaker: Player_Romus
540.text: "Is there another marriage candidate you have your eye on? Because I'm fresh out of ideas, myself."
540.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true) == false

542.speaker: Narrator
542.text: Vina wiped her eyes with the sleeve of her dress, ignoring her grandmother's admonishing look.

544.speaker: Player_Romus
544.text: "Your grandmother is right. You knew all along what would be expected of you."

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "Come now, Mother. You act as if marrying a handsome duke is a punishment."

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "It's not like that. Marry Axel and you can pursue whatever dreams you want to."

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "Your grandmother is right. It was never realistic of me to entrust you with choosing your own husband."

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "No, Mother. That's not going to be Vina's life. My daughter is free to choose her own future."

554.speaker: Narrator
554.text: After a moment, a look of resolve formed on her face.

555.speaker: Vina Toras
555.text: "Marrying Duke Reinhart is what's best for Rizia, isn't it?

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "I have absolutely no doubt that it is."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "Never mind the kingdom. I want what is best for you."

558.speaker: Player_Romus
558.text: "Don't ask me. Listen to your heart."

567.speaker: Vina Toras
567.text: "Then I choose Manus. Thank you, Father."

568.speaker: Vina Toras
568.text: "I'll do it, Father. I agree to marry Axel."

569.speaker: Vina Toras
569.text: "I'll do it, Father. I agree to wed the Duke of Pales."
569.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_ManusMarriage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 0)

573.speaker: Vina Toras
573.text: "Then I would rather not wed at all. Thank you for understanding."
573.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_ManusMarriage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 0) == false)

575.speaker: Vina Toras
575.text: "That's true. You never lied to me about that."

576.speaker: Vina Toras
576.text: "Any girl in Rizia would kill to have my life. I know."

578.speaker: Narrator
578.text: She rubbed her brow, deep in thought. Finally, she spoke again.

583.speaker: Vina Toras
583.text: "If you really believe marrying Axel is what's best for the kingdom.... I will do it."
583.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 3) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 3) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_ManusMarriage"] == true) == false)

593.speaker: Vina Toras
593.text: "I'm sorry, Father. It's Manus or no one."

600.speaker: Vina Toras
600.text: "I'm sorry, Father. I'm not going to marry a man I don't love just to make you happy."
600.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 3) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_TorasDinner_ManusMarriage"] == true) == false)

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "You don't understand, Vina. I am not giving you a choice. You will marry Axel Reinhart, and Rizia and Pales will be reunited."

602.speaker: Narrator
602.text: Tears sprang to Vina's eyes. Her lip trembled.

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "Very well. The strength of your feelings for the Sazon heir has convinced me. I shall sanction your marriage."

604.speaker: Narrator
604.text: Vina automatically opened her mouth in protest, then registered what I said.

609.speaker: Vina Toras
609.text: "I do hope Axel won't be too put out. "

610.speaker: Vina Toras
610.text: "I do hope Duke Reinhart won't be too put out."

612.speaker: Player_Romus
612.text: "If that's truly how you feel, then we will put your marriage plans on hold."

613.speaker: Narrator
613.text: Tears sprang to her eyes. She nodded gratefully.

618.speaker: Vina Toras
618.text: "I suppose I should be grateful. So thank you, Father."

620.speaker: Vina Toras
620.text: "May I please be excused? I need a moment."

623.speaker: Vina Toras
623.text: "I just need to figure out what to say to Manus."

624.speaker: Player_Romus
624.text: "He will. But that's my problem to deal with, not yours."

625.speaker: Player_Romus
625.text: "He'll find someone else to marry. He's incredibly good-looking, you know."

626.speaker: Player_Romus
626.text: "We still have our energy partnership. This marriage would have been a mere bonus."

630.speaker: Player_Romus
630.text: "It is not a step backwards. It is all part of God's plan for Rizia and this family."

631.speaker: Vina Toras
631.text: "I'd like to have a word with God about His plans, and why women's autonomy so rarely factors into them."

634.speaker: Narrator
634.text: Estela rose, her eyes full of sorrow.

635.speaker: Estela Toras
635.text: "It pains me to see her so miserable, Romus. Even if our kingdom will be better for it in the long run."

636.speaker: Player_Romus
636.text: "Not as put out as Queen Beatrice when she realizes we won't be bringing Pales into the fold."

637.speaker: Estela Toras
637.text: "In the short run, I'm going to go check up on the poor dear."

640.speaker: Estela Toras
640.text: "I'm sure he'll understand. You can always keep seeing him on the side, after all."

643.speaker: Player_Romus
643.text: "If you do, use caution. I want your children to have that Reinhart jaw."

644.speaker: Player_Romus
644.text: "Affairs are the backbone of any royal marriage. Just keep them hush-hush."

646.speaker: Estela Toras
646.text: "Pabel, some champagne? We've got an engagement to celebrate."

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "Give the Duke a chance first. He could surprise you, after all."

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "Allow me to saber it. There must be a sword around this room somewhere..."

653.speaker: Estela Toras
653.text: "Oh, we're getting ahead of ourselves. Pabel, some champagne? We've got a royal engagement to celebrate."

654.speaker: Narrator
654.text: He absconded to the kitchen and returned with a bottle.

658.speaker: Player_Romus
658.text: "Pour yourself a glass, Pabel. It's a special occasion!"

659.speaker: Player_Romus
659.text: "I shall abstain. Why don't you pour yourself a glass, Pabel?"

661.speaker: Player_Romus
661.text: "Sure, I'll take a glass. It's a special occasion."

662.speaker: Player_Romus
662.text: "From a more auspicious year, I hope."

664.speaker: Pabel Adria
664.text: "It's a very expensive vintage. Not to be wasted on butlers."

665.speaker: Narrator
665.text: Pabel nodded and filled our glasses.

670.speaker: Pabel Adria
670.text: "Yes, why not? I daresay I've been in a celebratory mood myself lately."

671.speaker: Pabel Adria
671.text: "I've taken the liberty of opening it already, Your Majesty."

672.speaker: Pabel Adria
672.text: "1948. The date of your first contact with Duke Reinhart, I believe."

673.speaker: Narrator
673.text: He filled our glasses, and Vina hoisted hers high. The hint of a smile was beginning to show on her face.

674.speaker: Vina Toras
674.text: "To a reunited Rizia. Perhaps this will be fun after all."

680.speaker: Narrator
680.text: Over dessert, we began discussing the wedding preparations.

682.speaker: Estela Toras
682.text: "That was uncalled for, Romus. Given more time, she might have been open to persuasion."

684.speaker: Narrator
684.text: She put down her fork and looked at me.
684.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaManus_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

688.speaker: Vina Toras
688.text: "When I went to Pales, I felt as if I had a real purpose."

693.speaker: Vina Toras
693.text: "I've done nothing but perform superficial princess duties since we moved to Porte Drazon."

694.speaker: Vina Toras
694.text: "For a time, my conversations with Manus were the only thing sustaining me. Now..."

695.speaker: Narrator
695.text: She leaned forward and looked me in the eye.

696.speaker: Vina Toras
696.text: "Between my time on the royal council and my trip to Pales, I've had a taste of what leadership is like."

700.speaker: Vina Toras
700.text: "My time on the council has taught me so much these past years. I've had a taste of what leadership is like."

701.speaker: Vina Toras
701.text: "Before that, my conversations with Manus were the only thing sustaining me. Now..."

702.speaker: Vina Toras
702.text: "Father... I confess I have been feeling rather aimless lately."

703.speaker: Player_Romus
703.text: "It sounds like you're ready for a new role. That of wife."
703.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)

705.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
705.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)

706.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
706.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)) == false

707.speaker: Player_Romus
707.text: "No time for existential crises, Vina. Duke Axel Reinhart has requested your hand in marriage."
707.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true)

709.speaker: Player_Romus
709.text: "I am sorry to hear that. But I have a proposal that could change everything. It is time for you to be wed."
709.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)

719.speaker: Vina Toras
719.text: "What? Is there a specific husband you have in mind for me?"

722.speaker: Player_Romus
722.text: "Do you know how privileged you are? Any girl in Rizia would kill to be you, and you're feeling 'aimless'?"

724.speaker: Vina Toras
724.text: "I know. But I can't help it."

727.speaker: Estela Toras
727.text: "A Rizian king sparing his daughter from an incestuous yet politically expeditious marriage is a novel concept indeed."

728.speaker: Estela Toras
728.text: "But if our princess is not going to get married, what shall she do?"

732.speaker: Estela Toras
732.text: "A Rizian king rejecting the political marriage opportunity of a lifetime because his daughter doesn't fancy the groom. Quite the novel concept."

733.speaker: Estela Toras
733.text: "But if our princess is not going to get married, what shall she do?"

736.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
736.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true

737.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
737.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == false)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaAxel_ProposedMarriage"] == true) == false

746.speaker: Vina Toras
746.text: "That's very flattering. But my answer is no."

753.speaker: Player_Romus
753.text: "Your Uncle Hugo will be quite cross at me for not insisting you marry his son."

757.speaker: Estela Toras
757.text: "My dear, if you don't want to marry Duke Dashing, I'll take him."

758.speaker: Estela Toras
758.text: "The road to the throne is paved with incestuous pairings, dear."

762.speaker: Estela Toras
762.text: "A Rizian princess, marrying her true love. Your grandfather would be proud."

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "I confess I'm not thrilled about it. But at least he isn't a commoner."

765.speaker: Player_Romus
765.text: "If this doesn't earn us House Sazon's support in the war, nothing will."

772.speaker: Player_Romus
772.text: "Her true love and the majority speaker in the House of Delegates. This will be unbelievably advantageous."

773.speaker: Player_Romus
773.text: "If this doesn't earn us House Sazon's support, nothing will."

774.speaker: Player_Romus
774.text: "Vina should be able to marry the person she loves. Everyone in Rizia deserves that right."

778.speaker: Estela Toras
778.text: "And they have it, thanks to you."

781.speaker: Estela Toras
781.text: "And the way the boy was carrying on before the war, he might as well be a commoner."

785.speaker: Estela Toras
785.text: "And the way the boy's been carrying on, he might as well be a commoner."

789.speaker: Estela Toras
789.text: "Assuming the boy makes it home alive, you mean."

790.speaker: Estela Toras
790.text: "You've already got the house eating out of the palm of your hand. Or maybe it's the other way around."

791.speaker: Narrator
791.text: She briefly glanced in the direction of the kitchen.

798.speaker: Estela Toras
798.text: "A real feather in the cap for Romus the Reformer."

799.speaker: Estela Toras
799.text: "You could use the help, it's true."

800.speaker: Estela Toras
800.text: "That's right. He threatens the monarchy, Vina threatens to shut her legs for a week."

803.speaker: Estela Toras
803.text: "What? Sex is as good a weapon as any to keep the Sazons in line."

804.speaker: Narrator
804.text: Vina almost choked on her food.

805.speaker: Narrator
805.text: She scooped the last bit of rice off her plate.

806.speaker: Vina Toras
806.text: "Manus and I have already started looking for a suitable residence in the capital."

807.speaker: Player_Romus
807.text: "Oh, he will be. But that's my problem to deal with, not yours."

808.speaker: Player_Romus
808.text: "The old man will be dead in a few years anyway."

809.speaker: Player_Romus
809.text: "Disappointing one's relatives is all part of being a royal. He will get over it."

810.speaker: Player_Romus
810.text: "Frankly, I'm more worried what Rico will get up to without a wife to tie him down."

815.speaker: Narrator
815.text: He filled our glasses, and Vina hoisted hers high.

819.speaker: Pabel Adria
819.text: "1951. The date of your first royal visit to the Sazons in Sallabes."

826.speaker: Player_Romus
826.text: "To the new faces of Rizian royalty."

828.speaker: Narrator
828.text: My mother had a frown on her face.

829.speaker: Estela Toras
829.text: "This was a grand opportunity, my girl. I hope you won't come to regret rejecting it."

830.speaker: Estela Toras
830.text: "But we're getting ahead of ourselves. Pabel, some champagne? We have an engagement to celebrate."

831.speaker: Vina Toras
831.text: "I need a moment. May I be excused?"

832.speaker: Narrator
832.text: Without waiting for an answer, she elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

834.speaker: Narrator
834.text: Estela stood as well, her eyes full of sympathy.

835.speaker: Estela Toras
835.text: "You can't keep the girl in a cage forever, Romus."

836.speaker: Narrator
836.text: She rose and pushed in her chair.

838.speaker: Vina Toras
838.text: "This has all been rather overwhelming. May I please be excused?"

839.speaker: Narrator
839.text: Without waiting for an answer, she elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

841.speaker: Narrator
841.text: My mother looked bemused as she watched Vina leave.

845.speaker: Estela Toras
845.text: "One moment she's ready to accuse you of murder, the next she's taking her rightful place as a Toras."

846.speaker: Player_Romus
846.text: "That's far more useful knowledge than anything you could learn on a council."

848.speaker: Player_Romus
848.text: "Her mother always had a keen mind."

849.speaker: Player_Romus
849.text: "I'm suspicious of her motives. Do you think she's plotting against me?"

851.speaker: Player_Romus
851.text: "It's best to keep her occupied. Who knows what she could get up to if she isn't?"

852.speaker: Estela Toras
852.text: "Where does she get it from? The only politics I was interested in at her age was which of your father's friends was sleeping with which actresses."

853.speaker: Player_Romus
853.text: "Superficial gossip is what being a Duchess is all about, isn't it?"

854.speaker: Player_Romus
854.text: "She's not interested in politics. She just wants to galivant around till she forgets her troubles."

855.speaker: Player_Romus
855.text: "She's wrong about my involvement, by the way. In case you had any doubt."

861.speaker: Estela Toras
861.text: "It's every girl's dream to turn into her father."

866.speaker: Estela Toras
866.text: "Keep an eye on her, Romus. That's all I'll say."

867.speaker: Estela Toras
867.text: "She still looks up to you. That's rare at her age."

870.speaker: Narrator
870.text: He came over to clear my plate, avoiding eye contact with me as he did so.

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "I made the right choice. Didn't I?"

872.speaker: Player_Romus
872.text: "Sit down. Have a drink with me."

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "You're judging me. You will stop it at once."

876.speaker: Pabel Adria
876.text: "Thank you, but I can't. We've hired a new dishwasher and she's still leaving streaks on the silver."

884.speaker: Pabel Adria
884.text: "Congratulations, Your Majesty. You've made Rizia a more free place for everyone but your own daughter."

885.speaker: Narrator
885.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) == false)

890.speaker: Narrator
890.text: He took my plate and walked away.

891.speaker: Narrator
891.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true)

892.speaker: Pabel Adria
892.text: "I see how it is now. If His Majesty can't be happy, nobody can. Including his own daughter."

893.speaker: Pabel Adria
893.text: "I would never judge you, Your Majesty."

898.speaker: Estela Toras
898.text: "As for the future of House Toras..."

899.speaker: Estela Toras
899.text: "You should strongly consider a back-up plan."

903.speaker: Estela Toras
903.text: "It will have to remain unwritten for now."

904.speaker: Narrator
904.text: She looked uneasily towards the kitchen.

908.speaker: Estela Toras
908.text: "I trust you will put family first."

909.speaker: Narrator
909.text: We finished our dinner and headed to our separate quarters.

926.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
926.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true) == false

928.speaker: Estela Toras
928.text: "Assuming the boy makes it home alive, you mean."

929.speaker: Estela Toras
929.text: "I hope you aren't expecting me to make nice with your new mother-in-law."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "Manus' mother has been given a full pardon. Your grievances are with a dead man."

937.speaker: Player_Romus
937.text: "You are speaking of the Duchess of Iza. Show some respect."

938.speaker: Player_Romus
938.text: "Don't worry, Mother. The traitor's wife will spend the rest of her life in exile."

939.speaker: Player_Romus
939.text: "If I can forgive Angelica Sazon, you should as well."

940.speaker: Player_Romus
940.text: "I have no plans to arrange her release. But she should at least be present at her son's wedding."

941.speaker: Player_Romus
941.text: "The kidnapping is far in the past, Mother. We have to look towards the future."

944.speaker: Narrator
944.text: Vina looked as if she were about to argue, then thought better of it.

947.speaker: Vina Toras
947.text: "We have to look at the Sazons as allies, not enemies."

948.speaker: Vina Toras
948.text: "Really, Father? That would mean the world to Manus."

949.speaker: Vina Toras
949.text: "What happened to Father was ghastly. But she had no part in it."

950.speaker: Vina Toras
950.text: "You should hear her plans for the city. It will be as if Rico was never there."

954.speaker: Vina Toras
954.text: "We both have duties here, after all. In fact, I was hoping to take on an expanded role on the Royal Council."

955.speaker: Vina Toras
955.text: "Though eventually I hope to begin splitting my time between here and Monqiz, if I am to take up the mantle of Duchess."

956.speaker: Player_Romus
956.text: "Don't get too greedy, young lady. You're only 23."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "You're already more than an observer. I've noticed you speaking up more often."

958.speaker: Narrator
958.text: My mother let out a loud laugh, then clapped a hand over her mouth.

960.speaker: Vina Toras
960.text: "Yes, well, I believe I've gained enough experience for my opinions to carry weight."

961.speaker: Narrator
961.text: My mother gave her a wry smile.

962.speaker: Estela Toras
962.text: "We'll see how much time you have for the council once the babies start coming, sweetheart."

963.speaker: Vina Toras
963.text: "Queen Lyza was making laws at age 23. So was Aunt Bea."

967.speaker: Vina Toras
967.text: "Honestly, Father, just because you spent your twenties in a drunken stupor doesn't mean everyone should--"

971.speaker: Player_Romus
971.text: "The very same royal council that you and Mr. Sazon plan to do away with?"

972.speaker: Vina Toras
972.text: "You'll need my help if you want to persuade the others of the need for reform. Especially Uncle Hugo."

973.speaker: Vina Toras
973.text: "How unfair. Would you say that to a man?"

974.speaker: Player_Romus
974.text: "That's favoritism, love. My councilors all earned their positions by merit."

975.speaker: Vina Toras
975.text: "Oh, Father. You know that's not true."

976.speaker: Player_Romus
976.text: "You're getting ahead of yourself, young lady. You're only 23."

977.speaker: Vina Toras
977.text: "You were about the same age when you became Duke."

978.speaker: Player_Romus
978.text: "I can think of no better candidate for the position."

982.speaker: Player_Romus
982.text: "A mere ceremonial title, if you and Mr. Sazon have your way."

983.speaker: Vina Toras
983.text: "But still an important one. Especially if we are to keep the members of House Toras on our side."

984.speaker: Vina Toras
984.text: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "A lovely idea. But a man and wife shouldn't live separately. Too much potential for temptation."

987.speaker: Narrator
987.text: My mother gave her a wry smile.

988.speaker: Estela Toras
988.text: "We'll see how much time you have for commuting once the babies start coming, sweetheart."

989.speaker: Player_Romus
989.text: "Vina has juggled multiple obligations throughout her life. I am confident she can balance motherhood and a royal career."

990.speaker: Player_Romus
990.text: "Precisely. Who says Vina even needs to have children?"

991.speaker: Player_Romus
991.text: "Don't worry about it, Vina. Your nannies and housekeepers will do most of the work, anyway."

992.speaker: Estela Toras
992.text: "Don't be naive, Romus. Producing a successor is non-negotiable."

994.speaker: Vina Toras
994.text: "I-- that isn't what I meant. But children are years in the future, anyway."

995.speaker: Player_Romus
995.text: "Your grandmother's right. Raising children is the most sacred duty you can perform for your kingdom."

996.speaker: Vina Toras
996.text: "It's important. But it is only one duty among many."

997.speaker: Estela Toras
997.text: "Your great-grandmother changed many rules for woman in Rizia. The expectations for wives and mothers were not among them."

999.speaker: Vina Toras
999.text: "I would ask for one thing in return, though."

1000.speaker: Narrator
1000.text: She leaned forward to look me in the eye.

1001.speaker: Vina Toras
1001.text: "Send me to Monqiz. I'm finally ready to take up the mantle of Duchess of Valenqiris."

1002.speaker: Player_Romus
1002.text: "You're getting ahead of yourself, young lady. You're only 23."

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "I can think of no better candidate for the position."

1005.speaker: Player_Romus
1005.text: "A largely ceremonial position, if you had your way."

1007.speaker: Estela Toras
1007.text: "A long-distance marriage will be frowned upon by traditionalists. But if this is what she wants, it's the least you can do."

1008.speaker: Narrator
1008.text: My mother gave me a wry smile.

1009.speaker: Vina Toras
1009.text: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

1010.speaker: Player_Romus
1010.text: "But Rico needs to stay in Iza. You wouldn't be living together."

1014.speaker: Narrator
1014.text: She rose and pushed in her chair.

1015.speaker: Vina Toras
1015.text: "This is all rather overwhelming. May I please be excused?"

1016.speaker: Player_Romus
1016.text: "Yes, all right. From now on, Vina Toras will be Duchess of Valenqiris as well as the fiancee of Duke Ricardus Toras of Iza."

1017.speaker: Narrator
1017.text: She thought it over for a moment, then nodded.

1021.speaker: Vina Toras
1021.text: "I want you to send me to Monqiz. Allow me to take the mantle of Duchess of Valenqiris."

1022.speaker: Player_Romus
1022.text: "You're getting ahead of yourself, young lady. You're only 23."

1023.speaker: Vina Toras
1023.text: "You were about the same age when you became Duke."

1024.speaker: Player_Romus
1024.text: "I can think of no better candidate for the position."

1025.speaker: Vina Toras
1025.text: "If the system isn't going to change, I can at least try to make people's lives better within it."

1028.speaker: Estela Toras
1028.text: "You and your father both used Valenqiris as a training ground for becoming king. There's no reason Vina shouldn't do the same."

1029.speaker: Narrator
1029.text: My mother gave me a wry smile.

1030.speaker: Vina Toras
1030.text: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

1031.speaker: Player_Romus
1031.text: "I thought you had misgivings about the monarchy. Now you want to become a Duchess?"

1032.speaker: Narrator
1032.text: She broke into a wide smile.

1034.speaker: Player_Romus
1034.text: "Yes, all right. From now on, Vina Toras will be Duchess of Valenqiris."

1036.speaker: Player_Romus
1036.text: "No. My mind is made up. Vina will stay in Porte Drazon."

1038.speaker: Estela Toras
1038.text: "For some, yes. But for your daughter..."

1044.speaker: Pabel Adria
1044.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_Together"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false)

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "Wait. I still have your mother's ring. I want you to wear it at the wedding."

1054.speaker: Narrator
1054.text: She elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "He's not so bad. You might learn to love him.

1057.speaker: Player_Romus
1057.text: "It's for the good of the kingdom. You'll thank me someday."

1061.speaker: Player_Romus
1061.text: "Wait. I still have your mother's ring. I want you to wear it at the wedding."

1062.speaker: Player_Romus
1062.text: "He's not so bad. You might learn to love him."

1063.speaker: Player_Romus
1063.text: "It's for the good of the kingdom. You'll thank me someday."

1064.speaker: Narrator
1064.text: She looked like she was about to be sick. Without replying to me, she fled the dining room, nearly knocking over Pabel on the way out.

1065.speaker: Narrator
1065.text: Before I could answer, she pushed back her chair and abruptly stood up.

1069.speaker: Player_Romus
1069.text: "Wait. I still have your mother's ring. I want you to wear it at the wedding."

1070.speaker: Player_Romus
1070.text: "He's really not so bad. You might learn to love him."

1071.speaker: Player_Romus
1071.text: "It's for the good of the kingdom. You'll thank me someday."

1072.speaker: Narrator
1072.text: She looked like she was about to be sick. Without replying to me, she fled the dining room, nearly knocking over Pabel on the way out.

1076.speaker: Player_Romus
1076.text: "Wait. I still have your mother's ring. I want you to wear it at the wedding."

1077.speaker: Vina Toras
1077.text: "Oh, Father. It would be an honor."

1080.speaker: Player_Romus
1080.text: "Never mind. You're obviously not ready yet."

1081.speaker: Narrator
1081.text: My mother flashed me a grateful glance.

1082.speaker: Estela Toras
1082.text: "It's best to keep yourself busy. You'll forget about him before you know it."

1083.speaker: Player_Romus
1083.text: "It's a shame. You're one of my most valuable councilors."

1084.speaker: Vina Toras
1084.text: "But I can't gain the experience I need unless I strike out on my own."

1085.speaker: Player_Romus
1085.text: "It's your choice, Vina. It always has been."

1087.speaker: Player_Romus
1087.text: "The son of my kidnapper wouldn't be my first choice, of course. But your happiness comes above all else."

1088.speaker: Player_Romus
1088.text: "Honestly, if you didn't choose him as a suitor, I would have."

1093.speaker: Player_Romus
1093.text: "Vina Reinhart, Queen of Rizia and Grand Duchess of Pales. Doesn't that have a nice ring to it?"

1098.speaker: Vina Toras
1098.text: "I can't bear it anymore. Father, why did you do it?"

1099.speaker: Vina Toras
1099.text: "And I think I'm ready for more."

1106.speaker: Vina Toras
1106.text: "If you're serious about reforming Rizia, you'll need help on the inside."

1107.speaker: Vina Toras
1107.text: "Please, Father. It's the only thing that will get my mind off of Manus."

1111.speaker: Vina Toras
1111.text: "Please, Father. If I can't be with the person I love, at least grant me this."

1112.speaker: Narrator
1112.text: My mother let out a loud laugh, then clapped a hand over her mouth.

1113.speaker: Vina Toras
1113.text: "Queen Lyza was making laws at age 23. So was Aunt Bea."

1117.speaker: Vina Toras
1117.text: "Honestly, Father, just because you spent your twenties in a drunken stupor doesn't mean everyone should--"

1118.speaker: Player_Romus
1118.text: "Forget it, Vina. You'll neither marry Ricardus nor become Duchess. You'll stay right here in Porte Drazon until we find you another marriage candidate."

1119.speaker: Estela Toras
1119.text: "There are other noblewomen out there for Ricardus. Men like him always fall upwards."

1120.speaker: Narrator
1120.text: Vina was only half-listening to us.

1121.speaker: Vina Toras
1121.text: "Now that the marriage has been settled on, we'd better start looking for a residence in the capital."

1122.speaker: Vina Toras
1122.text: "Never. My future is with Manus. I know it."

1123.speaker: Vina Toras
1123.text: "In fact, now that the marriage has been decided on, we'd better start looking for a residence in the capital."
